style: Premium studio product photograph for a fitness app. One single piece of equipment, plain and unbranded, centred with generous empty margins on a seamless warm stone-grey backdrop (#D8D3CC) that fades slightly darker at the edges. One large soft key light from above left, a gentle contact shadow on the floor, true-to-life materials (matte black rubber, brushed steel, black upholstery), crisp focus, no people, no hands. Photoreal, calm and minimal. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, labels, stickers, watermarks or signage anywhere.

images.prompt: A pair of matching black rubber hexagonal dumbbells with knurled steel handles, lying side by side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above.
One black cast-iron kettlebell with a smooth round body and a wide handle, standing on the floor, seen from a three-quarter angle at handle height.

images.alt: A loaded barbell with black plates
images.prompt: A steel Olympic barbell loaded with one large black rubber bumper plate on each end, lying on the floor, seen at a low three-quarter angle so the whole bar fits in frame.
Three plain looped latex resistance bands of different thickness in charcoal, terracotta (#C44933) and sand colours, loosely coiled and overlapping on the floor, seen from above at an angle.
A black steel doorway pull-up bar with foam grips, shown on its own, floating slightly above the floor with a soft shadow beneath, seen from the front at a slight angle.
An adjustable weight bench with black upholstery and a black steel frame, backrest set flat, seen from a three-quarter angle.
A sturdy plywood plyometric box with rounded edges and a hand hole on the side, seen from a three-quarter angle.
A black steel power rack (squat cage) with J-hooks and safety arms, an empty barbell resting on the hooks, seen from a three-quarter angle so the whole rack fits in frame.
A dual-pulley cable crossover machine (functional trainer) in black steel with two weight stacks and adjustable pulleys, seen from the front at a slight angle so the whole machine fits in frame.
A plate-loaded 45-degree leg press machine in black steel with black upholstery, seen from the side at a three-quarter angle so the whole machine fits in frame.
A Smith machine in black steel: a barbell fixed on vertical guide rails inside a frame, with a flat bench under it, seen from a three-quarter angle so the whole machine fits in frame.
An indoor rowing machine with a black frame and a dark flywheel housing, seen from the side at a three-quarter angle so the whole machine fits in frame. The small display is blank and dark.
